messages:
lena: Quick sync — vendor asked how we credit customers when spot is used as backfill against reserved commitments. Need partner-side inputs on 'backfill window' and eviction credit rules.
nikhil: high level ask: can partners provide a CSV with (region, sku, reserved_commit_hours, typical_backfill_window_hours, eviction_credit_pct, notes)? small sample ok.
carlos: from ops POV we usually see backfill windows of 1-6h depending on maintenance/eviction patterns. In eu-west it's often 2-3h.
lena: @carlos can you paste a 1-row example so partners know format?
carlos: sure — example: ```region,sku,reserved_commit_hours,typical_backfill_window_hours,eviction_credit_pct,preempt_priority_tag
eu-west,gpu-v100-32,720,3,0.15,priority-low```
ashley: two asks: 1) define how eviction_credit_pct maps to billing (e.g., pro-rated token credits vs invoice credit line) and 2) whether credit caps apply per-account per-month.
nikhil: suggested mapping: credit = min(backfilled_hours / reserved_commit_hours, 1.0) * reserved_rate_per_hour * eviction_credit_pct. Cap = partner-specified or default 20% of monthly commit cost. Thoughts?
carlos: that formula seems workable. vendors will want a cap to avoid runaway refunds.
lena: also need clarity on how spot-sparing works — if partner offers 'spot-sparing' (short-term holdback) vs true preempt, does that change crediting? we should ask partners to mark `preempt_priority_tag` so we can route billing logic.
vendor-bot: vendor_feed_2026-03.csv uploaded to /shared/partnerships/vendor-feeds/2709876510.csv (contains preliminary backfill windows for 12 SKUs).
ashley: awesome — I'll pull and sanity-check. @lena can you own partner follow-up to get explicit cap values and whether they prefer invoice credits or usage-credit lines?
lena: I can. I'll also ask partners to provide historical eviction frequency for each SKU (simple percent of hours evicted per month) — helps calibration.
carlos: FYI ops: if eviction frequency > 30% we should treat that SKU as 'unstable' and exclude from commitment modeling.
nikhil: action items: lena -> collect CSVs + eviction freq + cap preference; ashley -> build small pricing spreadsheet with formula + cap scenarios; carlos -> flag unstable SKUs and share ops notes.
lena: ok I'll ping vendor PMs now and share this thread. :thumbsup:
